scope: 07 only, CPU and archive only. Fixed-inventory 223 star. All eligible parents at all ten beta, final individual seed codes 6101,6102,6103 from 03, depths 10257 b00-b08 and 10218 b09. No consensus, retraining, new sampling, new trajectories or 08. TEST held from these forecasts but used in prior distinct questions.
targets: Exact q_B from 03 conditional p_B times frozen four-label membership and s_B=sum q_B^2. Targets only, never predictors. Structural unused labels are masked identically in all heads using the frozen map, with exactly zero mass. All supported labels have positive TRAIN marginal. Stable log-softmax, 0 log 0 = 0. Constant code returns exact constants, not a useful prediction.
views: Only su (species on 18 L1=2 axial/diagonal sites) and fu (their occupied NN counts after subtracting ALL cavity neighbors) enter features. Per site: 1_A, 1_B, fu, fu^2, fu*1_A, fu*1_B. Packing = mean of each channel per cubic orbit (6 axial/12 face-diagonal sites, 12 columns). Directional = same means plus position-resolved channel minus its orbit mean (108 extra columns). Rotation control = same directional pipeline after one uniformly assigned proper cubic rotation per parent, original labels fixed. Geometry and rotation preserve packing. Never input energy, q, s, observed interior, interior field, anchor coordinates/count or any target-derived row weight.
splits_and_selection: Deterministic keyed SHA256 of (beta index, chain seed, chain ID), distinct domains for folds and rotations. First 8 digest bytes little endian mod 3 for folds and mod 24 for rotations. Every TRAIN parent is validation once in three folds and in final refit. New TEST targets only after all fits, coefficients, signs and slices are locked to disk. Per beta, seed and view, soft-label multinomial logistic ridge with unpenalized intercept, standardized nonconstant columns using fold-fit population mean/SD; mean natural-log CE plus lambda/2 squared Frobenius norm. Separate strength head: least-squares ridge (mean squared error/2 plus same penalty) with unpenalized intercept, clipped [1/4,1] for scoring. Both select lambda independently over [0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.1], lowest held-TRAIN OOF CE or clipped MSE respectively; numerical ties within 1e-12 take largest lambda. L-BFGS with tight tolerance and convergence logged. No hidden layers or tuning on TEST. Prior = TRAIN mean q, strength baseline = TRAIN mean s, NOT norm squared of forecast q.
primary: Expected soft log loss bits/cavity on independent TEST parents. Paired differences prior-packing, packing-directional, rotated-directional (positive is a gain); also directional-prior improvement and full oracle H(H|B), TEST marginal H, I=H-H(H|B), TRAIN-prior excess. Cold primary succeeds per seed if lower 95% limit packing-directional >0.01 bit, all three required for joint claim. Rotation contrast separately. Intermediate temperatures descriptive. Pointwise two-sided paired Student-t 95% intervals; fits conditional, parents independent; no pooling seeds. Label calibration: reliability of predicted modal probability against exact q at predicted modal label, expected modal success, agreement with true mode and soft Brier; smaller label breaks modal ties. Display representative q/predictions at TRAIN confidence 10/50/90 percentiles, nearest TEST confidence only, ties by roster order, no selection by outcomes.
strength: Separate clipped ridge strength forecast for each view. MSE, paired MSE reduction vs TRAIN constant and vs packing/control, Pearson and Spearman only if SD>1e-10 in both series. Report correlation conditional on these fits, target SD, prior collision, mean true entropy, mean s and dispersion for every seed and beta. Fixed equal-width deciles on [0.25,1] for strength reliability and [0,1] for modal-label reliability, show number of TEST parents. Cold ambiguity = s<.8; flag predicted strength strictly below corresponding TRAIN 10th percentile (no ties forced). Recall/precision with Wilson 95% if >=30 ambiguous and >=30 nonambiguous parents, >=30 flagged for precision. No inference about tail recovery otherwise. Saturation and failure to explain variance visible.
interpretability: For each label select the opposed-site channel difference with largest absolute TRAIN Pearson correlation with q(label) over nine opposed shell pairs and six channels. Orient sign positively on TRAIN; fixed +/- groups (strict nonzero). TEST table reports positive and negative counts, mean exact label mass and predicted mass, paired-to-boundary bin uncertainty; minimum 50 per side for supported comparison. Constant categories not interpreted. These are correlations, not causal interventions. Parent-level held IDs, target vectors, fitted forecasts, folds, rotations, all validation losses and coefficients saved for audit.
